findings.title: Name the pre-migration Embedded Signup idempotency replay case explicitly.

evidence.observation: The new official method is bound before nonce reservation and included in idempotency payload semantics; existing official rows are backfilled to EMBEDDED_SIGNUP.
Migration and idempotency tests are required, but a replay of an attempt created with the old payload shape is not individually named.
The current requestHash hashes the original create input without an authorization-method field and uses it to identify a same-payload replay.
A different recomputed requestHash returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT before returning the original attempt/nonce.
The existing test protects same-input replay and one-use nonce within one source/schema version.

findings.analysis: A backfilled provenance column alone does not explain how a request created under the old payload shape is normalized after the change. A naive implementation could add an explicit default method to every recomputed payload hash and make an otherwise identical historical retry conflict. This is a possible implementation pitfall, not an observed defect in the current source or a new architecture requirement. The frozen plan already requires migration coverage and unchanged Embedded Signup semantics, so it does not block planning approval.

recommendation.action: Within the existing migration/idempotency evidence, add a named PostgreSQL case using a pre-change official attempt/requestHash, apply the provenance migration, and replay its equivalent Embedded Signup request. Assert the same attempt, correct safe method projection and expected same-session nonce behavior, while a LOCAL_TEST method change on that key still fails. Cover NAO_OFICIAL null provenance in the already required migration case.

summary: The bounded local technical entry is coherent and proportionate: it adds an explicit, default-off, fixed-resource candidate authorization source and converges on the existing confirmation, ownership, encryption, active-credential and receipt contracts. The corrected qualification contract is executable in principle with the named adapter and no longer claims token-class or explicit-expiry evidence. No material planning blocker remains. Actual token eligibility and implementation correctness remain unproved, mandatory future gates.

previousResolutionReview.assessment: The prior token-only authorization mismatch is removed. No private method, OAuth exchange, Nest bootstrap or DB is needed. Successful return plus the helper canonical-phone check can support the fixed boolean result without exposing raw grant payloads. The helper may use no additional private key by inference. Base config is validated for accepted app/version, and source/image/module attestation happens before credentials. The current adapter does not inspect token type or explicit expiry, and the revised contract says exactly that. An unavailable/stale module or extra required input is preflight_failed, not permission to improvise.

correctness.position: Acceptable planning contract; no material correctness blocker found.
correctness.rationale: A server-pinned LOCAL_TEST attempt is selected before reservation and carries immutable provenance in persisted state and idempotency intent. Its separate nonce-only route can stage the same encrypted candidate after current-grant/exact-phone reads. Confirmation remains explicit and JA_REGISTRADO-only. Both method/route directions must reject mismatches before OAuth exchange or provider register. Backfill preserves official Embedded Signup provenance while nonofficial rows remain null. No synthetic CODE_CONSUMED state is needed.
correctness.residual: There is no implementation. Opposite-route rejection, historical normalization, candidate clearing, target filtering and recovery behavior require the stated integration evidence.

architecture.position: The chosen convergence is sound and retains one channel lifecycle.
architecture.rationale: The only new trust source is explicit private bootstrap configuration for one local resource. It is not a new public API, active credential store, receipt path or message resolver. The existing confirmation transaction is the durable authority for BU canonical phone, resource ownership and credential promotion; post-promotion normal advance retains the current-app subscription boundary. Legacy direct-channel creation stays rejected.
architecture.residual: Root-owned canonical module consolidation must occur as planned; this review does not silently supersede the module OAuth entry contract or approve a product diff.

security.position: The high-impact trust entry has suitable planned constraints; no new approval-blocking security plan gap found.
security.rationale: Private local configuration pins one BU/WABA/phone/token and grants no application permissions. Current session plus target-BU ADMIN remains mandatory, including after network waits; a configured target cannot be exposed by the current tenant-only capability signature without supplying and checking actor context. The new POST remains under prefix session/anti-CSRF protections and exact actor/session/nonce/attempt/lease controls. Client tokens, target overrides, fake OAuth, SQL seeds, global send fallback and missing granular grants are explicitly forbidden. Candidate and active storage retain authenticated encryption/AAD. The debug_token query is the narrowly named existing provider HTTPS exception; it does not license browser, CLI, callback, artifact or arbitrary secret-bearing URLs.
security.requiredExecutionProof: Use per-operation provider counters and transaction/barrier assertions for route/method mismatch, forged NOVO/PIN, revoked session/admin grant, replay, config disable/target/token changes and same-resource ownership conflicts. Assert no old candidate promotion, active-credential replacement, foreign resource detail or secret-bearing error/audit/log output. Keep helper output fixed on both success and failure.
security.residual: No private configuration, concrete grant, actual error capture or implementation was inspected. Neither this planning approval nor handset delivery establishes credential eligibility.

codeQuality.position: Feasible within the named service/controller/adapter/schema/UI seams, with bounded change.
codeQuality.rationale: One small local configuration policy shared by capabilities and candidate operations can avoid duplicated shape/target logic; adding no helper is also acceptable if policy remains coherent. Reuse existing public grant validation and candidate crypto rather than copy private adapter validation or subclass around it. The persisted method should drive controller/domain/UI behavior, including resumed attempts; transient UI selection cannot be trusted as its source. Exact request shape validation should reject unsupported fields.
codeQuality.residual: Implementation review must confirm policy consistency and absence of scattered special cases. No generic configuration framework, new credential platform or unrelated service rewrite is justified.

tests.position: The planned evidence is proportionate and covers the behavior that could fail; one optional migration timing case is recorded above.
tests.rationale: The plan calls for PostgreSQL migration/locking/rollback/race evidence, adapter negative tests, one-use nonce/idempotency/method tests, safe errors, unchanged Embedded Signup and NAO_OFICIAL regressions, plus browser navigation against the built Web bundle and real Nest/PostgreSQL validation backend. Existing browser doubles replace external provider ports, not BFF responses, and the named fixture seams can admit safe fake local config. Green aggregate suites alone do not prove LOCAL_TEST had zero exchange/register calls or exact-source consumer behavior.
tests.requiredExecutionProof: Separate counters for local versus Embedded Signup cases; local authorization/confirmation must have zero exchangeCode and zero register, while any subscribe belongs only to explicit normal post-mapping advance. Browser evidence must exercise enabled/disabled target-admin visibility and actual API requests, method persistence on resume, safe failures and stale-operation suppression. Fake signed-webhook integration is domain evidence; real handset/provider delivery remains a separate later proof.
tests.residual: No test was run. Architecture adherence, adversarial security, independent TQA, final review and actual canonical suite artifacts remain pending.

performance.position: Acceptable for the single-resource local slice, with future EPS evidence still required.
performance.rationale: Capabilities do no provider fan-out. The helper uses one public exact-target call with one debug read plus at most two phone pages, fixed HTTPS host/version, page size100, timeout10s per request, no retry/redirect and a40s outer bound. Normal operations retain the existing bounded3-request/10s and45s lease contracts, with no provider HTTP inside a DB transaction. Extra grant reads at distinct authorization/confirmation boundaries are intentional trust revalidation, not permission for unbounded resource discovery.
performance.residual: Actual request counts, deadline/abort handling, transaction wait behavior, query cost and latency are unmeasured. EPS/FRC/BCI remain required and pending. RLS not_needed is proportionate; this local path does not justify a production load platform.

concurrency.position: The intended checks are explicit enough for implementation planning; evidence must establish them through final promotion.
concurrency.rationale: Current source provides a channel lease, currentAttempt/generation/version checks after HTTP, durable provider-resource uniqueness, BU phone locks and active-credential version comparison. The local method must add current private source/target validation to each candidate use, after network waits and at final transaction/promotion, without turning active consumers into bootstrap-config dependents. Comparing the decrypted candidate token with the current pinned policy is a proportionate implementation option; the plan does not require a global rotation/version service.
concurrency.residual: Do not treat an earlier capability response, pre-network local-config check or prior qualification result as a commit fence. Barrier tests must show disabled/rotated candidates cannot win, the current lease alone is released, and existing active credentials/identity remain intact.

elegance.position: Coherent and proportionate; retain this narrow design.
elegance.rationale: One explicit source discriminator and guarded entry action feed the same candidate and confirmation path. A small wizard choice adds the accepted capability without another lifecycle. Qualification reuses a single public adapter method and fixed result schema. No fake callback, hidden global credential, manual mapping or parallel activation path is necessary.
elegance.residual: Avoid opportunistic auth-framework, vault, job/outbox, generalized feature-control or deployment expansion. Shared policy should express one rule instead of repeated ad hoc conditionals.

structuralSoundness.position: Sound ownership and persistence boundaries; no brittle shortcut is required.
structuralSoundness.rationale: Authorization provenance belongs on the shared attempt and is nullable for nonofficial rows. It is not a second active credential authority. Durable identity keeps its BU owner after detach; candidate promotion remains the only active-token transition. Subscription, signed ingress, receipt and outbound resolution continue using the stored current identity/credential. Removing bootstrap after promotion changes eligibility for new authorization, not ownership or the existing envelope.
structuralSoundness.residual: The additive migration must establish the official-only invariant and immutable method behavior in PostgreSQL, with NAO_OFICIAL still null. No schema or migration exists for this slice yet.

operationalFit.position: Fits the explicit local, single-resource direction and existing Docker validation topology.
operationalFit.rationale: The opt-in is independent of NODE_ENV, which is appropriate when a local installation may run a production-mode build. The dedicated BU is created through normal administrative behavior before its private ID is pinned. Blank examples and API-only local compose wiring can support the feature without secret client env, broad runtime changes or deployment promotion. Existing safe disposable runner and browser API fixture support are named. Neither bootstrap disable nor provider read success certifies continuous service or webhook reachability.
operationalFit.residual: Actual local private setup, accepted runtime module/image freshness, app subscription and real signed inbound/outbound remain unproved. Human-controlled later setup and distinct live/execution GOs are still required; parent VAL05 remains independent.
